_comment-vendored: VENDORED into vibe3d (task 0616). Single-header image decoder, upstream nothings/stb @ 013ac3beddff3dbffafd5177e7972067cd2b5083 (stb_image.h v2.30), dual-licensed MIT / public domain (Unlicense) -- see LICENSE. stb_image.h is byte-identical to upstream; stb_image_impl.c is the local translation unit that instantiates the implementation, restricts the compiled format set, disables the stdio path, and sets the compile-time dimension cap -- see PATCHES.md. Built with CMake+Ninja, mirroring third_party/nfde's shape -- that prerequisite is already required by this build (nfde), and it sidesteps a real failure mode: routing a single-file C library through dub's own built-in C-source compilation (its ImportC front end) fails on this project's dev host because the system libc headers use a C23 `nullptr` construct ImportC does not parse -- CMake invokes the platform's actual C compiler instead.
